plugins.name: file-size-guard
plugins.description: Blocks oversized Java and MyBatis mapper XML before they are committed. New files: 800 lines (src/main) / 1200 lines (src/test). Baselined files may shrink, never grow.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 提交前拦截过大的 Java 与 MyBatis Mapper XML：新文件 src/main 限 800 行、src/test 限 1200 行；基线内文件只许变小、不许再长。以插件开关控制启停。
